name: [🔥] Jump to Steal Brainrots!
desc:
Jump to Steal Brainrots! 🏃‍♂️

⚠️ Jump and Steal Brainrots hidden on platforms!  ⚠️
👮 Don't get caught by the Guards! 
🏠 Bring them back to your Base to earn Cash!
⚡ Upgrade your Jump - Reach Higher platforms!

If you're having fun, don’t forget to hit the thumbs up! 👍
